name: Topview Motion Studio
tagline: Create launch videos without touching After Effects
description: Motion Studio helps teams create polished launch videos for apps, hardware, and new products without learning After Effects or hiring a motion design studio. Describe what you want to communicate, upload reference images, and choose a visual style, duration, and aspect ratio. Motion Studio combines AI video models with purpose-built motion design skills to turn your brief into high-quality product storytelling—faster, simpler, and at a fraction of the traditional cost.

name: Hyperfocus
tagline: Planner that turns goals into daily progress
description: Hyperfocus is a free, goals-first planner for macOS. It helps you choose the few outcomes that matter most, plan weeks and days around them, and make consistent progress by doing focused work

name: Olostep
tagline: Turn the Web into Clean Data for AI
description: Olostep provides scalable web data APIs, specifically designed for the web’s second user - AI. Effortlessly turn any URL into LLM-ready Markdown, JSON, or structured data and use the API for agentic search workflows

name: Prequel
tagline: Create cinematic screen recordings on your Mac
description: A macOS screen recorder that hands back a finished video. Zooms that follow the work, a framed camera and a background, exported at up to 4K on your Mac's own media engine.

name: Murfy AI
tagline: Write, review, and publish to arXiv 10x faster
description: Murfy is a team of AI agents for the entire research writing workflow. Murfy helps to write and review your paper in context, fix LaTeX compile errors on the spot, verify reference papers and generate Beamer slides in minutes. Work with unlimited collaborators, real-time editing, free to start.

name: Referent
tagline: The AI-native OS for modern law firms
description: Referent is AI-native legal practice management software. Legal AI agents handle the operational work while lawyers focus on clients and growth.

name: Ravioli
tagline: Create custom stamp shapes
description: Ravioli is a tiny design tool for creating custom postage-stamp shapes. Select a shape, adjust the stamp size, holes and roundness, then export your result as a transparent PNG or scalable SVG.

name: RIP MY BUILD
tagline: Give your abandoned side project one last launch
description: RIP MY BUILD is a side project cemetery for honest public postmortems. Publish a permanent obituary with the original link, cause of death, lesson learned, and whatever you’re building next. Every memorial gets a shareable page, visitor roses, permanent plot adornments, and a weekly honors leaderboard. It turns the useful truth at the end of a project into closure, a launch asset, and a path to the founder’s next chapter. $12 per obituary; no account needed to browse.

name: Ulpaso
tagline: Stop paying just to take meeting notes
description: Your meeting-notes app wants the recording, an account, and a card. Ulpaso doesn't. Press record. Mic + system audio get transcribed on your Mac and land in a Markdown file you can actually edit. No cloud. No login. No $20/mo for a checklist.

name: Superagent
tagline: Claude Code for the rest of us
description: Working with a coding agent should feel like using a good Mac app, not a terminal. Superagent gives yours a computer: a real browser it drives on your own logged-in sessions, an iOS Simulator it taps and swipes, your files, a board it keeps, routines on a timer. Chats sit in a sidebar you can group, survive restarts, and never steal your focus. Each runs on its own git worktree. Pair your iPhone and the work follows you, encrypted end to end. No account, no server, no second bill. Open source.

name: Maritime
tagline: Dedicated computers for AI agents, starting at $1/month
description: Maritime helps companies that sell AI agents give every customer an agent with its own computer. Each agent runs in an isolated, persistent VM where it can use a browser, create files, run code, and keep its state. Maritime handles the infrastructure, scaling, and automatic sleep/wake, so you don’t have to build and manage thousands of VMs yourself. Built for companies running agents at scale, starting at $1 per agent per month.

name: Sayscroll
tagline: The AI Teleprompter that scrolls as you speak
description: SAYSCROLL is an AI teleprompter that follows your voice, so you can speak naturally instead of constantly adjusting your scroll speed. It supports 60+ languages and works across videos, demos, presentations, and live content. - Built-in video recorder —Record yourself while reading your script - Improvise —The prompter waits while you go off script - Browser based —No downloads or setup - Studio-ready controls —Text size, column width, alignment, +mirror controls for pro screens

name: oMLX
tagline: Mac LLM server that cuts agent wait times from 90s to 5s
description: oMLX turns your Mac into a full LLM inference server, run from the menu bar. It serves text, vision, OCR, embedding and reranker models with continuous batching, plus a RAM+SSD tiered KV cache that survives restarts, so Claude Code and Cursor respond in about 5s instead of 90s. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible APIs drop straight in. Native Swift, not Electron. Apache 2.0, open source.

name: Retro Y2K Theme
tagline: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme
description: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme. Enjoy nostalgic web aesthetics, and classic UI designs! Back to 2000 has never been easier! RawY2K is the ultimate retro website modifier that transforms any modern web page into a vintage 90s and Y2K aesthetic experience. Customize your browser with custom cursors, nostalgic Windows 98 UI, and classic GeoCities style themes instantly. Relive the golden age of the internet where the web was raw, fun, and full of chaotic creativity.

name: Edge Drop
tagline: Clipboard on your screen edge. Hover to open, drag to drop
description: Win+V makes you stop working. Edge-Drop doesn't. It lives on the edge of your Windows screen - invisible until you hover. Then a clipboard shelf springs open. Copy text, screenshots, files, or links and drag them straight into any app. Stack files, pin keepers, stay in flow. No shortcuts, no tray, no account. History never leaves your PC. Free and open source. Windows 10 and 11. GitHub or Microsoft Store.

name: Skud
tagline: Menubar file delivery with your brand and tracking
description: Skud lives in your Mac menubar. Drop any file → uploads, copies a branded link, tracks who opens it. Custom brand (logo, colour, cover image), password protection, expiration control. Free for 1 GB deliveries. Built for designers and studios who want ownership.

name: Caplio
tagline: Find, organize, and reuse every image on your Mac
description: Caplio turns scattered screenshots and images into a private, searchable library on your Mac. Think of it as a lightweight asset manager for screenshots and everyday images. Add your folders, and Caplio automatically watches, indexes, and extracts text with on-device OCR. Browse by timeline, search, or category; organize files automatically, then drag any image straight into another app. No uploads or cloud OCR. Your images stay on your Mac.

name: Softorino Online Converter
tagline: Free & Safe online file converter. No ads. No bs.
description: Privacy first is the core. Everything happens on your device, so your files never get uploaded anywhere. Convert video, music, voice memos & GIFs right in your browser – no sign-up, no ads, no watermarks, no limits. Handles MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A & more. Free forever, from the team behind WALTR.

name: Harshith's Newsletter
tagline: Useful AI field notes from real builds
description: Harshith's Newsletter turns real AI consulting, training, workflow, and agent builds into short notes you can use. See what worked, what broke, and which operating decisions mattered. No theory dump.

name: Záboj
tagline: Voice AI for your car that gets things done
description: Záboj is a voice AI assistant for your car - CarPlay, iPhone and web. It answers in 30+ languages, searches the web and acts through your tools via MCP: calendar, email, Slack, CRM. Debrief a meeting while driving - the note and follow-up land on their own.
